headline: Stlican Shelf Weathered Expanse Lead Fierce Fronts
war_summary: Since the 06:00 edition the war has sharpened on a handful of sectors. Stlican Shelf now logs eleven ownership changes in the past two hours and fifty‑four in the last day, the heaviest turnover on the map, though its hourly casualty rates have eased while two‑hour trends show both sides cooling. Weathered Expanse follows closely with nine flips in two hours and fifty‑eight daily; colonial losses are accelerating on the two‑hour window while Warden losses steady. Callahan’s Passage has awakened, posting four recent flips and eighteen total, with casualties cooling short‑term but still climbing on the two‑hour measure. Dead Lands remains a high‑casualty corridor (sixteen daily flips) but has gone quiet in the last two hours. Godcrofts records twenty‑three daily changes, its recent tempo modest but steady. Linn Mercy contributes twelve daily events and eight in the last six hours, its casualty curves cooling across both windows. Enlistments are rising on all of these active fronts, signalling fresh troop commitments, while the majority of other regions report little or no recent activity.
